title: Powerlock
summary: Powerlock is a spell that allows a Seeker to sacrifice one of his or her Titans to gain the Titan's energy, drastically powering up the Seeker. It is very similar to Powermark.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
This spell was used by a [[Casterwill Hunter]] on a [[Nighlurker]] Titan when fighting against [[Dante Vale]] and [[Montehue]] on an uninhabited Indonesian island during the mission [[Rise from the Ashes]]. The energy given by the sacrificed Titan allowed for the Casterwill Hunter to cast a [[Bladewave]] spell strong enough to rip a hole through the ground, collapsing a nearby lava tube.{{Source|The Dead Magic Island}}

'''Powerlock''' is a spell that allows a [[Seeker]] to sacrifice one of his or her [[Titans]] to gain the Titan's energy, drastically powering up the Seeker. It is very similar to [[Powermark]].

== History ==
This spell was used by a [[Casterwill Hunter]] on a [[Nighlurker]] Titan when fighting against [[Dante Vale]] and [[Montehue]] on an uninhabited Indonesian island during the mission [[Rise from the Ashes]]. The energy given by the sacrificed Titan allowed for the Casterwill Hunter to cast a [[Bladewave]] spell strong enough to rip a hole through the ground, collapsing a nearby lava tube.{{Source|The Dead Magic Island}}
